meta.title: Front User Submit demo
meta.description: Live Preview on WordPress.org: the free plugin with its demo form. The Freemius opt-in is skipped, otherwise it covers the plugin menu. The demo terms go on the Hello world post because the demo form hides empty terms.
meta.author: Aharonyan

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; if (function_exists('fe_fs')) { fe_fs()->skip_connection(); } $category_ids = []; foreach (['News', 'Events', 'Reviews'] as $name) { $term = wp_insert_term($name, 'category'); if (!is_wp_error($term)) { $category_ids[] = $term['term_id']; } } wp_set_post_categories(1, $category_ids); wp_set_post_tags(1, ['community', 'photos', 'tips']);
